units.title: The Basics
units.description: Survival English — introduce yourself and navigate simple situations

lessons.title: Hello & Introductions
lessons.topic: personal information, greetings, names, where you are from
lessons.grammar: verb to be (am/is/are), personal pronouns (I, you, he, she)

lessons.title: Articles & Nouns
lessons.grammar: a/an/the, singular and plural nouns

lessons.title: Daily Routines
lessons.topic: daily habits, times of day, frequency
lessons.grammar: present simple (I eat, she works), adverbs of frequency (always, never, sometimes)

lessons.title: Numbers, Time & Dates
lessons.topic: telling the time, days of the week, months
lessons.grammar: prepositions of time (at, on, in), cardinal and ordinal numbers

lessons.title: Asking Questions
lessons.grammar: question formation with Wh- words (what, where, when, who, why, how)

units.title: Getting Around
units.description: Handle everyday situations — travel, shopping, describing the past

lessons.title: Past Simple — Regular Verbs
lessons.grammar: past simple with -ed endings, time expressions (yesterday, last week, ago)

lessons.title: Past Simple — Irregular Verbs
lessons.grammar: common irregular verbs (went, saw, ate, had, did, came, took)

lessons.title: Comparatives & Superlatives
lessons.grammar: comparative (-er / more) and superlative (-est / most) adjectives

lessons.title: Modal Verbs — Basics
lessons.grammar: can, can't, should, shouldn't, must, have to

lessons.title: Future Plans
lessons.grammar: going to (plans), will (spontaneous decisions, predictions)

lessons.title: Common Phrasal Verbs
lessons.grammar: wake up, get up, turn on/off, look for, give up, pick up

units.title: Speaking Your Mind
units.description: Express opinions, talk about experiences, handle most conversations

lessons.title: Present Perfect
lessons.grammar: have/has + past participle, ever/never, just/already/yet

lessons.title: Present & Past Continuous
lessons.grammar: was/were + -ing, while vs when, time clauses

lessons.title: Zero & First Conditionals
lessons.grammar: if + present simple + present simple / if + present simple + will

lessons.title: Gerunds vs Infinitives
lessons.grammar: verb + -ing (enjoy, avoid, stop) vs verb + to (want, decide, hope)

lessons.title: Linking Words
lessons.grammar: however, although, because, so, therefore, despite, in spite of

units.title: Complex Ideas
units.description: Discuss abstract topics, debate, write formally

lessons.title: Passive Voice
lessons.grammar: is/are + past participle, was/were + past participle, passive with modals

lessons.title: Second Conditional
lessons.grammar: if + past simple + would/could/might

lessons.title: Third Conditional
lessons.grammar: if + past perfect + would have + past participle

lessons.title: Narrative Tenses
lessons.grammar: past simple + past continuous + past perfect together

lessons.title: Relative Clauses
lessons.topic: defining and describing people, places, things
lessons.grammar: who, which, that, where, whose — defining and non-defining clauses

lessons.title: Advanced Modal Verbs
lessons.grammar: must/can't/might/could + have + past participle (past modals)

units.title: Mastery
units.description: Nuanced, fluent communication — academic, professional, persuasive

lessons.title: Mixed Conditionals
lessons.topic: complex hypotheticals mixing past and present
lessons.grammar: if + past perfect + would + infinitive (and vice versa)

lessons.title: Inversion & Emphasis
lessons.grammar: never have I, not only did, hardly had, seldom does — fronting for emphasis

lessons.title: Nominalisation
lessons.grammar: turning verbs/adjectives into nouns (decide → decision, develop → development)

lessons.title: Advanced Connectors
lessons.grammar: notwithstanding, insofar as, with a view to, on the grounds that, inasmuch as

lessons.title: Cleft Sentences
lessons.topic: highlighting specific information in speech and writing
lessons.grammar: It is/was... that/who, What I need is..., What happened was...
